page.layout: One page, all text centred in a title block, with a woodcut engraving below the text and the imprint under it. No margins, running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: Woodcut between the title and the imprint: a cloud with the Hebrew tetragrammaton יהוה in it, a tree, and two figures, one kneeling and planting, one standing and watering. A pencilled "3" below the imprint is handwriting and is left out. The printed "Ꝺ" and "s" forms are normalised as described in the rules; the long s is written as s throughout.
